bear_case: The Week 2 post-FOMC pattern (8-of-9 weakest weeks) is asserting itself on June 22: SPX opened 56–69 points below Sunday futures (7,487–7,500 vs 7,556), VIX opened briefly above 17 before recovering, and DXY held at 100.76 despite being expected to approach 100 based on weekend FX. Warsh's 'no forward guidance' posture means any June 22–25 Fed speaker could use the equity recovery as justification for maintaining the hawkish 3.8% median dot — a single hawkish Fed speech between now and June 24 could reverse the DXY improvement within hours and push VIX above 17 sustainably. The Micron Q3 bar is the highest it has ever been (revenue $34.66B, EPS $19.95, gross margin >80%; all revised up 3.1% in 30 days) — if MU delivers revenue of $34.0–$34.3B (technically a 'beat' vs older estimates but a 'miss' vs current consensus), the AI memory bull thesis gets its first real test. The 30Y at ~4.90% is 10 bps from the 5.00% gate — a PCE print on June 25 that comes in above 2.8% core could push the 30Y through 5.00% and reintroduce the multiple-compression regime that defined the June FOMC selloff.
